$comment: The repair fallback chain advances through codex (task default), codex-alt (Astra high), and claude (the existing Claude launcher). Argon is opt-in in custom chains, but its launcher remains unavailable until a confined repair adapter exists; unavailable rungs are skipped. Settings cascade from the standard default to platform fixExecutor.fallbackChain, this file, then env WE_FIX_EXECUTOR_FALLBACK_CHAIN (comma list or JSON array). ["codex","claude"] restores the pre-chain behaviour; fixExecutor.criticalClaudeFromRung follows the same cascade (env WE_FIX_EXECUTOR_CRITICAL_CLAUDE_FROM_RUNG): integer >=1, default 2, a zero-based chain index threshold for critical work to reach Claude. Index 1 stays on codex-alt by default; setting 1 restores the previous critical escalation behaviour.
